content:
STAGE: scope + evidence check of four proposals (round scoring_3, rubric rank-2026-10-v1).
GOAL: decide whether each proposal satisfies the five scope conditions and which evidence items bear on the placement.
READ: the four proposal texts and the four frozen evidence bundles (9637a2495b60c669 CURVCAP-SUCCPLAN; 634a0d7731a5d022 CURVCHART-EQUIMARGIN-RQ; dfec9cb5b35ea444 CURVCHART-RESGUARD; 6476469bc16f6590 CURVEBEND-NORM-RESIDUAL).
OBSERVED: all four name a training-only transition signal, an explicit curved operation, a single connected pathway and behaviour-off/geometry-off/both-on switches; all four are in scope. The decisive observed evidence is shared across bundles: E8 first-level capacity ceiling (K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822 positive pair share), E11 baseline same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067, E6 beam survival (l1_br 0.04671 with depth-1 survival 1.000 and T4 NLL 9.03; l1_br_euclid 0.06207; l1_only 0.06233; resample 0.06363; successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500; tangent_successor_residual 0.05500), E5 successor-entropy top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543, E10 edge density 5.33 / out-degree 5.45.
REASONING: the frozen baseline already exports 247/7414/20223 SIDs, so the 2/13/56 collapse was caused by spending curvature on the radius and is the failure to design against; level-1 prefix information is the measured deficit; residual-space hyperbolic variants have already underperformed Euclidean l1 arms; and E8/E5 argue against hard uniform code marginals.
OPEN: nothing outstanding on scope; final ordering still to be recorded.

STAGE: placement decision.
GOAL: place the four in-scope proposals by the evidence and the one-run, no-ablation, no-tuning policy.
READ: same four bundles; no new data.
OBSERVED / REASONING:
1 CURVCHART-RESGUARD: code vectors, norms, count and EMA update are byte-identical to the inherited baseline, so the 247/7414/20223-level resolution cannot be lost; only a bounded [0.5,2] per-code chart gain touches the assignment, and it acts at level 1 where E11 (0.0907 vs 0.067 null) and E8 (K=256 share 0.0822) show the information deficit is; it is also the cheapest (<2% step) and states its own <0.5%-change no-op falsifier, which makes one run decisive.
2 CURVCAP-SUCCPLAN: per-pair curvature from successor fractions is the most direct behaviour coupling and the Euclidean column counts anchor resolution, but argmax over a capacity-constrained Sinkhorn plan does not itself enforce the column counts, so the "exact Euclidean support" claim is not structural, and its own risk list concedes a possible <1% permutation no-op; cost 1.0-1.8x step is the highest.
3 CURVCHART-EQUIMARGIN-RQ: real per-code quotient field, but hard uniform 1/K marginals (B/K ~ 4 per code) are contradicted by E8 (K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822) and E5 (top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543); its 2-of-256 diagnosis belongs to the failed radius run, not the frozen baseline (247 level-1 codes).
4 CURVEBEND-NORM-RESIDUAL: leaves level 1 Euclidean, so it cannot address E11's first-token deficit or E6's degenerate l1_br (depth-1 survival 1.000, T4 NLL 9.03); residual-level hyperbolic arms already trail Euclidean l1 arms in E6 (0.05500 vs 0.06207/0.06233), it carries one kappa per level only, and it changes residual direction while preserving norm, adding uncosted reconstruction error.
OPEN: none; final answer recorded next.

STAGE: complete answer.
RANK: CURVCHART-RESGUARD | position=1 | reason=Only proposal whose code table, norms, count and EMA update are copied byte-identically, so it cannot repeat the 2/13/56 collapse (0.041888), while it still spends per-code training-graph curvature on the level-1 assignment that E11 shows is uninformative (same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs 0.067 null) and E8 shows is already at the K=256 ceiling (0.0822); its bounded [0.5,2] chart and explicit <0.5%-change no-op falsifier make one run decisive at <2% step cost.
RANK: CURVCAP-SUCCPLAN | position=2 | reason=Its per-pair Poincare curvature c_ik=c_l*exp(-a_ik) built from the fraction of an item's top-M training successors already in a code is the most direct behaviour-geometry coupling, and freezing column marginals to the Euclidean counts directly answers the E8 K=256 ceiling and the prior radius collapse; placed second because the argmax of a capacity-constrained Sinkhorn plan does not itself enforce the column counts, so the exact-support guarantee is not structural, and its own risk list concedes a possible <1% permutation no-op at the highest added cost (1.0-1.8x step).
RANK: CURVCHART-EQUIMARGIN-RQ | position=3 | reason=The per-code quotient-graph curvature field and switches are sound, but its remedy is a hard uniform 1/K column marginal (about 4 items/code per step), which E8 (K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822 positive pair share) and E5 (top-1 successor mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543 across entropy quintiles) say will split the genuinely hierarchical clusters; its 2-of-256 level-collapse diagnosis belongs to the failed radius run, not the frozen baseline that already exports 247 level-1 codes.
RANK: CURVEBEND-NORM-RESIDUAL | position=4 | reason=It deliberately leaves level 1 Euclidean, so it cannot touch the first-token information deficit identified by E11 (0.0907 vs 0.067 null) and E6 (l1_br depth-1 survival 1.000 with T4 NLL 9.03), and the evidence already shows residual-level hyperbolic variants trailing Euclidean l1 arms (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 and tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207 and l1_only 0.06233); with one level-global kappa only and a norm-preserving direction bend that injects uncosted reconstruction error, it has the weakest behavioural bandwidth and the least evidence support.

GOAL: rank the four frozen proposals for round rank-2026-10-v1.
READ: full frozen evidence bundles for CURVCAP-SUCCPLAN (9637a2495b60c669), CURVCHART-EQUIMARGIN-RQ (634a0d7731a5d022), CURVCHART-RESGUARD (dfec9cb5b35ea444), CURVEBEND-NORM-RESIDUAL (6476469bc16f6590); all share E4-E11 and differ in E12/E13.
OBSERVED: E6 width-20 beam survival: l1_br 0.04671 (gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068), l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363 (best), successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500. E7 NLL: l1_br T1/T2/T3/T4 = 0/0/0/9.03; l1_br_euclid 0/3.22/4.36/1.23; resample 4.55/3.82/0.73/0.05. E8 K=256 cluster share 0.0822 vs neg 0.0129; small K shares much more. E9 positive shares successor cohort 0.9291 vs 0.8871. E11 baseline same_first_prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067; prior CURVALLOC exported 2/13/56, collision 0.998, recall 0.041888 vs baseline 247/7414/20223, 0.055537.
REASONING: Independent checks applied. (a) CURVCAP freezes Sinkhorn column marginals to the Euclidean nearest-code counts, so curvature can only permute occupancy, never shrink support; per-pair c_ik=c_l*exp(-a_ik) is a direct successor-community coupling, matches E5/E9 successor structure and E11's weak-but-nonzero 0.0907-vs-0.067 transition alignment. (b) EQUIMARGIN hard-uniform marginals guarantee U_l but force equal spreading at K=256, contrary to E8's small-K cohesion and aiming at a collapse that the baseline (247 L1 codes) does not exhibit; its own risk says a near-uniform curvature field degenerates to the plain uniform-Euclidean assignment. (c) CURVEBEND uses the exact coarse-minus-fine deviation the 115-family analysis found predictive, and leaves the codebook untouched, but it rotates the residual rather than the metric, so the next level reconstructs a non-actual residual (reconstruction-objective risk) and may be high-dim noise. (d) RESGUARD is the most rigorous and safest (codebook byte-identical, [0.5,2] guard band) but self-admits a <0.5% assignment-change no-op; E11's 0.0907-vs-0.067 margin is small. Net: structural reassignment with resolution preserved ranks above bounded weighting; among structural ones the successor-coupled capacity-freeze is better evidenced than uniform flatness.
OPEN: final ranking order to be recorded.

FINAL ANSWER (round rank-2026-10-v1).
RANK: CURVCAP-SUCCPLAN | position=1 | reason=E5 successor-entropy stratification (top1 mass 0.4375 low-entropy vs 0.0543 high) and E11's real but weak transition alignment (same_first_prefix 0.0907 vs permuted 0.067) support per-pair c_ik=c_l*exp(-a_ik) successor-community curvature, while freezing Sinkhorn column marginals to the Euclidean counts keeps the baseline 247/7414/20223 support and structurally blocks the prior 2/13/56 collapse; strongest single connected behaviour+geometry pathway.
RANK: CURVCHART-EQUIMARGIN-RQ | position=2 | reason=Hard uniform column marginals make U_l>=0.9K_l a constraint, directly avoiding the E6 l1_br collapse (recall 0.04671, T4 NLL 9.03), and the spec is complete with derived kappa_0 and an automatic alpha decay; but forcing equal spreading at fixed K=256 runs against E8's small-K cohesion (K=256 share 0.0822 vs 0.0129) and its own risk notes a near-uniform field degenerating to plain uniform-Euclidean assignment.
RANK: CURVEBEND-NORM-RESIDUAL | position=3 | reason=Uses exactly the level-1-minus-level-l curvature deviation that the 115-family analysis found predictive (Spearman -0.20) and targets levels 2/3 where E7 shows the informative arms live (l1_br_euclid T3/T4 NLL 4.36/1.23; E6 depth-3/4 prefix survival 0.161/0.085), with the codebook and L1 untouched; but it rotates the residual instead of the metric, so the next level reconstructs a non-actual residual and the bend may be high-dim noise.
RANK: CURVCHART-RESGUARD | position=4 | reason=Most rigorous and safest (byte-identical codebook, derived c0_l, [0.5,2] guard band, <2% step cost), but the bounded per-codeword reweighting can only perturb the baseline Voronoi diagram and the proposal itself disconfirms at <0.5% assignment change; against E11's small 0.0907-vs-0.067 prefix margin this is the least likely of the four to move test_recall@10 from 0.055537 toward 0.065.
